review_basis.predecessor_gate: D089 coordinator gate accepted before D090

decision_rationale: Python owns the current versioned readthrough/materialization behavior. The D090 Java definition is read-only and preserves the old physical object for compatibility; no second Java writer or compute owner was introduced. Evidence verifies the bounded live compatibility read against the current view.
limitations_reviewed: The physical-table comparison covers the first 200 ordered keys on one real date, not the full historical table.
The Python cache-fill path was not invoked because a cache miss may write; its owner and source-version safeguards were inspected in source.
The callable legacy Python materializer remains and its full rebuild branch can drop the formal table; D090 did not run it.
The default whole-workspace Gradle compile remains blocked by unrelated incomplete Moneyflow/D024/D026 sources documented in D089; the D090 dependency slice compiled with --release 24.
